#!/bin/bash
set -e
cat > /etc/modprobe.d/disable-algif.conf << 'EOF'
install algif_aead /bin/false
EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/modprobe.d/disable-algif.conf
modprobe -r algif_aead 2>/dev/null || true
